anomalies.observed: The RJ45 data pins J4.R1/R2/R3/R6 are individually unconnected. The corresponding SKW92A LAN1 pins U3.5–U3.8 are on separate nets, each shared with a keyboard matrix pin on U1, not with the RJ45.
anomalies.expected: For the fitted RJ45 to provide Ethernet, its transmit and receive pairs should connect to the SKW92A Ethernet PHY pairs (with any required magnetics/pair mapping).

evidence.quote: J5 | RJ45 Amphenol RJMG1BD3B8K1ANR | Ethernet jack
the RJ45 jack J5's data pads ... all appear in the netlist as individually unconnected

anomalies.impact: The RJ45 connector cannot carry Ethernet data, so wired Ethernet through the fitted jack will not work. The specification notes this connectivity as an open item, but the netlist confirms the functional disconnection in this build.

parsed.summary: The RJ45 data contacts are unconnected, while the SKW92A LAN1 pins are on separate nets. This leaves the fitted Ethernet jack nonfunctional; the specification also records the disconnection but leaves its intended status unresolved.
